headline: Budget for SS4A Main Street Signals project at $1,470,800, and on-call water excavation contracts up to $500,000 each.
summary: The agenda includes a $460,855 airport contract to replace automated vehicle wash systems and a $50,000 state grant for pavement markings. It also covers a Town Meeting TV update and the city's FY28 budget request.

Subject 3.4. State of Vermont AOT Grant Acceptance for Traffic Markings — 
DPW/Division of Parking and Traffic  
    
Meeting November 9, 2026 - Board of Finance Meeting - Monday, November 9, 2026, 5:00 PM, 
Bushor Conference Room, 149 Church Street, 1st Floor  
  
Category 3. Consent Agenda 
  
  
Department Public Works Department 
  
Type Action (Consent) 
 
    
Recommended Action to approve and recommend that the City Council approve the Director of Public Works, 
or his designee, to accept a grant from the State of Vermont Agency of Transportation 
for the amount of $50,000 for the purpose of installing pavement markings in 2027 and 
to execute a grant agreement and any other documents necessary or convenient to 
accept the grant, subject to review and approval as to form by the City Attorney’s Office  
    
   
Subject 3.5. Request to execute a contract with Maintenance Tech., Inc. — Airport  
    
Meeting November 9, 2026 - Board of Finance Meeting - Monday, November 9, 2026, 5:00 PM, 
Bushor Conference Room, 149 Church Street, 1st Floor  
  
Category 3. Consent Agenda 
  
  
Department Patrick Leahy Burlington International Airport 
  
Type Action (Consent) 
 
    
Recommended Action to approve and authorize the Director of Aviation to execute a contract agreement with 
Maintenance Tech., Inc. for $460,855.00 with a maximum spending limit of $475,000.00 
for the replacement of the automated vehicle wash systems at the airport’s Quick Turn 
Around (QTA) Facility, subject to review and approval of the City Attorney's Office

Subject 4.2. Authorization to Establish SS4A Main Street Signals Project Budget — 
DPW/Parking & Traffic  
    
Meeting November 9, 2026 - Board of Finance Meeting - Monday, November 9, 2026, 5:00 PM, 
Bushor Conference Room, 149 Church Street, 1st Floor  
  
Category 4. Deliberative Agenda  
  
  
Department Public Works Department 
  
Type Action 
 
    
Recommended Action 1. To approve and recommend the City Council authorize the Director of Public Works to 
establish the SS4A Main Street Signals project budget in the amount of $1,470,800 with 
a required local match of $294,000, subject to review by the Office of the City Attorney.  
2. To approve and recommend the City Council authorize the Chief Administrative 
Officer, or her designee, to effectuate necessary budget amendments and transfers of 
funds to create the project budget, including executing a Budget Amendment (BA) to 
move the required funds into the project  
    
   
Subject 4.3. Authorization to Execute Contracts with On-Call Water Resources 
Excavation Contractors — DPW/Water Resources  
    
Meeting November 9, 2026 - Board of Finance Meeting - Monday, November 9, 2026, 5:00 PM, 
Bushor Conference Room, 149 Church Street, 1st Floor  
  
Category 4. Deliberative Agenda  
  
  
Department Public Works Department - Water Resources 
  
Type Action 
 
    
Recommended Action to recommend that the City Council authorize the Director of Public Works to execute 
Main On-Call Agreements with three (3) water resources excavation contractors (BP 
Wastewater Services LLC, Engineers Construction, Inc. and S. D. Ireland Brothers 
Corporation), each with a maximum limiting amount of $500,000.00, subject to review 
and approval by the City Attorney
